task.question: What was the outcome of the 2026 São Toméan presidential election in July?
task.evidence: July 19 – The 2026 São Toméan presidential election was held, with incumbent nonpartisan President Carlos Vila Nova re-elected for a second five-year term.

answer: FINAL: In the 2026 São Toméan presidential election held on July 19, 2026, incumbent president Carlos Vila Nova won re-election in the first round with 55.88% of the vote (31,613 votes), running as an independent candidate with support from the MLSTP–PSD party.
